## Summary
Seed all reference/enum nodes into Neo4j: BloomLevel (6), MillerLevel (4), SessionType, DifficultyBand (5), LeadInType, ClinicalSetting, PatientAgeGroup, AssessmentMode, and ResourceType — the foundational enumeration nodes that all other graph structures reference.

## User story
As a developer, I want reference nodes seeded in Neo4j, so that item generation and assessment pipelines can reference valid enum values (Bloom levels, difficulty bands, etc.) from the graph.

## Why this matters
Reference nodes are foreign keys in the knowledge graph. Without them, P3 item generation cannot set valid bloom_level, difficulty_band, or clinical_setting on AssessmentItems. Missing reference nodes cause constraint violations during batch generation.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] 6 BloomLevel nodes created: Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create
- [ ] 4 MillerLevel nodes created: Knows, Knows How, Shows How, Does
- [ ] 5 DifficultyBand nodes created: Easy, Medium, Hard, Very Hard, Expert
- [ ] SessionType nodes created for all valid session types
- [ ] LeadInType nodes created for all valid question lead-in types
- [ ] ClinicalSetting nodes created for all valid clinical settings
- [ ] PatientAgeGroup nodes created for all valid age groups
- [ ] AssessmentMode nodes created for all valid assessment modes
- [ ] ResourceType nodes created for all valid resource types
- [ ] All nodes carry institution_id for tenant isolation (Rule 1)
- [ ] Seed is idempotent (MERGE, not CREATE — safe to re-run)
- [ ] Script uses neo4jQuery wrapper (Rule 1)

## Code patterns to follow
```typescript
// scripts/seeds/01-reference-nodes.ts
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'

const BLOOM_LEVELS = [
  { name: 'Remember', level: 1 },
  { name: 'Understand', level: 2 },
  { name: 'Apply', level: 3 },
  { name: 'Analyze', level: 4 },
  { name: 'Evaluate', level: 5 },
  { name: 'Create', level: 6 },
]

async function seedReferenceNodes(institutionId: string) {
  // MERGE for idempotency — safe to re-run
  for (const bloom of BLOOM_LEVELS) {
    await neo4jQuery(
      `MERGE (b:BloomLevel {name: $name, institution_id: $institution_id})
       ON CREATE SET b.uuid = randomUUID(), b.level = $level, b.created_at = datetime()
       ON MATCH SET b.level = $level, b.updated_at = datetime()`,
      { name: bloom.name, level: bloom.level },
      institutionId
    )
  }
  // ... repeat for each reference type
}
```

## Code patterns to AVOID
```typescript
// ✗ AP-01: Raw neo4j-driver import
import neo4j from 'neo4j-driver'  // BANNED — use neo4jQuery

// ✗ CREATE instead of MERGE — not idempotent
await neo4jQuery('CREATE (b:BloomLevel {name: $name})', ...)  // WRONG — duplicates on re-run

// ✗ Missing institution_id — tenant isolation violation
await neo4jQuery('MERGE (b:BloomLevel {name: $name})', { name: 'Remember' }, '')  // WRONG
```

## Automated tests (Playwright — runs during /validate)
```typescript
// tests/E01/E01-S04.seed.test.ts
import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test'
import { neo4jQuery } from '@journey/neo4j/client'

const TEST_INSTITUTION = process.env.TEST_INSTITUTION_ID ?? 'test-institution-001'

test('Acceptance: 6 BloomLevel nodes exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (b:BloomLevel {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN b.name as name, b.level as level ORDER BY b.level',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records).toHaveLength(6)
  expect(result!.records[0].name).toBe('Remember')
  expect(result!.records[5].name).toBe('Create')
})

test('Acceptance: 4 MillerLevel nodes exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (m:MillerLevel {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN m.name as name ORDER BY m.level',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records).toHaveLength(4)
})

test('Acceptance: 5 DifficultyBand nodes exist', async () => {
  const result = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (d:DifficultyBand {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN d.name as name ORDER BY d.ordinal',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(result).not.toBeNull()
  expect(result!.records).toHaveLength(5)
})

test('Acceptance: all reference types have institution_id', async () => {
  const labels = [
    'BloomLevel', 'MillerLevel', 'DifficultyBand', 'SessionType',
    'LeadInType', 'ClinicalSetting', 'PatientAgeGroup', 'AssessmentMode', 'ResourceType'
  ]
  for (const label of labels) {
    const result = await neo4jQuery(
      `MATCH (n:${label} {institution_id: $institution_id}) WHERE n.institution_id IS NULL RETURN count(n) as orphans`,
      {},
      TEST_INSTITUTION
    )
    if (result) {
      expect(result.records[0].orphans).toBe(0)
    }
  }
})

test('Acceptance: seed is idempotent (re-run does not duplicate)', async () => {
  const before = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (b:BloomLevel {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(b) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  // Re-run seed
  const { execSync } = await import('child_process')
  execSync('pnpm tsx scripts/seeds/01-reference-nodes.ts')
  const after = await neo4jQuery(
    'MATCH (b:BloomLevel {institution_id: $institution_id}) RETURN count(b) as count',
    {},
    TEST_INSTITUTION
  )
  expect(before!.records[0].count).toBe(after!.records[0].count)
})
```

## Rollback procedure
If implementation fails mid-way:
1. Remove all reference nodes: `MATCH (n) WHERE n:BloomLevel OR n:MillerLevel OR n:DifficultyBand OR n:SessionType OR n:LeadInType OR n:ClinicalSetting OR n:PatientAgeGroup OR n:AssessmentMode OR n:ResourceType DETACH DELETE n`
2. `git stash && git checkout develop`
